messages.content: Write the introduction to a public product roadmap for a developer tools company. Around 200 words.

output:
Here's the intro — around 200 words. Bracketed bits are the places to drop in your own specifics.

---

## What we're building next

This page is our working plan, published as we work it.

We keep it public because you make architecture decisions on our behalf. If you're deciding whether to write your own [caching layer] or wait for ours, guessing is expensive — for you in rework, for us in support tickets from people who guessed wrong. So we'd rather tell you.

Three things to know about how to read it.

Dates are estimates, and the further out an item sits, the softer the estimate. Anything in "Shipping" has code merged and a release date. Anything in "Exploring" is a problem we've agreed is real and haven't yet agreed how to solve; some of those items will die here, and we'll say so when they do rather than letting them rot at the bottom of the list.

Order comes from three inputs: support volume, what breaks in production, and what you tell us directly. Not vote counts. A single issue from a team running [our agent on 400 nodes] usually outweighs fifty thumbs-up on a nice-to-have.

Disagree with the ordering? [Open a discussion] or reply on any item. We move things.
